area.note: Owner decision: walking distance only, so this map is the Downtown campus. OSM relation/15630375 'West Virginia University' outlines the university's land (Downtown, Evansdale and Health Sciences, linked by the PRT); the box limits it to Downtown, from the Woodburn Circle end north past Summit Hall (Grant Ave) and the Life Sciences Building.

noCodes: WVU's building key (linked from wvu.edu/faq/where-are-my-classes-located and facilitiesplanning.wvu.edu Building Information) and campusmap.wvu.edu answer scripts with HTTP 403 (bot challenge); the readable health.wvu.edu/hub/morgantown-campus/building-codes covers Health Sciences buildings only.
